project.title: Payment Webhook Dispatcher
project.content:
# Payment Webhook Dispatcher

Contact: jane.doe@example.com · https://github.com/janedoe/webhook-dispatcher

## Architecture

Built a fault-tolerant webhook delivery service in C# with ASP.NET Core and PostgreSQL. Packaged the service with Docker and deployed it to Kubernetes with GitHub Actions CI/CD.

cases.name: strong-fit-dotnet-platform
cases.jobPosting:
Senior Backend Engineer (.NET)

Acme Payments is looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join our platform team.

What you will do:
- Design and build APIs for our payment services.
- Mentor other engineers.

Requirements:
- 5+ years of professional experience with C# and .NET.
- Solid experience with PostgreSQL.
- Experience building REST APIs.
- Experience with Docker.
- Fluent English.

Nice to have:
- Kubernetes.
- Terraform.

We offer remote work and a learning budget.
